args.title: Ironbark Tooling — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Ironbark Tooling’s latest newsletter highlights its outlook on cold-chain logistics in 2026 and links to the main analysis plus a companion piece.
- The main article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- The companion piece says pilot programs cut claims by 25%, reinforcing the operational and financial value of shared real-time monitoring.
